title: Comparison of the ph and etale topologies: a_X^{-1} and the vanishing of R^i epsilon_{X,*}
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — More on Cohomology of Spaces

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-comparison-ph-etale at source lines 1888-1898: for a sheaf F on X_etale one has epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F and a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, and for torsion abelian F one has R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0. The author's proof at source lines 1900-1955 proves part (1) from the explicit description of pi_X^{-1} together with the fact (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context) that pi_X^{-1}F is already a ph sheaf, and then proves part (2) by reducing to the case of schemes: using that higher direct images of epsilon_{X,*} are the sheaves associated to the presheaves U -> H^p_ph(U,-), that every object of the small etale site has a covering by schemes, an identification of the cohomology over (Spaces/U)_ph with that over (Sch/U)_ph (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies, retained as context, plus a general restriction fact declared as a pointer), and finally the corresponding scheme statement (a cross-chapter pointer, used twice). The author explicitly notes that the reader is urged to skip the proof of part (2); that remark is reproduced verbatim.
